recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, vignetted sepia-toned studio portrait of a young boy in formal attire, set against a neutral, textured background with decorative inline display typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-to-subject spatial balance in upper third
Monochromatic sepia tonal range across all elements
coreInvariants: Soft-focus vignetted edges on the portrait

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered bust-up portrait, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the decorative display text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves to the large display text at the top right, then to the smaller metadata in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room around the head, creating a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown shadows in the suit and hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone tan for skin and background texture
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high tonal range from cream highlights to deep chocolate shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical strokes are composed of multiple parallel thin lines (inline style)
Terminals end in large, circular ball serifs or swash-like curls
Extreme contrast between thick vertical structures and thin horizontal connectors
characterSpecificRedesigns: R characters feature extended, curling tails
Y features a deep, symmetrical bowl with curled terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly decorative display face paired with functional, minimalist sans-serif metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the inline multilinear structure and classic serif proportions.
Captures the extreme contrast and Victorian-influenced ball terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned studio portrait of a young boy in a 1960s suit and tie. The image should have a soft vignette at the bottom, fading into a textured beige paper background. The lighting should be soft and directional.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, all-caps title in the upper right using an inline decorative serif font with ball terminals. Add small sans-serif metadata text in the top left and top right corners. All text should be in a dark chocolate brown.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia?
Does the main text feature the multilinear inline effect?
Is the portrait vignetted at the bottom edges?
Is the overall aesthetic consistent with 1960s lithography?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the inline font decoration
postGenerationChecks: Check for multilinear strokes in the display font.
Ensure the vignette is soft and not a hard circle.
Verify the sepia tone is warm and consistent across text and image.
Confirm the layout maintains the specific corner-weighted balance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered vintage-style portrait + apply a heavy sepia wash + add a soft bottom vignette + overlay high-contrast inline serif typography in the upper right quadrant.
